purpose: Phase 4 — Coordinated Framework & Toolchain Majors (Task 5.1 / FR7/FR8 / AC7/AC8). Per-migration quality-gate schema; the w4 Red-phase TDD suite asserts this fixture exists with the four required top-level categories (npm_ls, npm_audit, boundary_check, per_app_quality_gates) and per-migration subsections (W4-T1 vinext, W4-T2 vite+plugin-react, W4-T3 next+eslint-config-next, W4-T4 typescript+eslint+@eslint/js). Green behavior: a w4 Green commit (per-migration) runs the actual quality-gate commands for that migration and writes the results into the matching per_migration_quality_gates entry.

npm_ls.summary: Clean. No dependency-tree problems across the 5 apps and 19 active shared packages. Required to hold after EACH W4 per-migration install.

npm_audit.summary: 0 critical / 0 high; the 14 moderate advisories are dispositioned in w3-advisory-disposition.json. W4 majors must not introduce new critical/high findings.

boundary_check.summary: No monorepo boundary violations after W4 framework majors. W4 must not introduce a new cross-boundary import (test-strategy.md §4).

per_app_quality_gates.purpose: Per-app lint/test/typecheck/build status captured after EACH W4 per-migration install (Task 5.1). Each migration commit re-runs the full per-app gate so a wave that flips a previously-green app to red is attributable to that migration.

per_migration_quality_gates.purpose: Task 5.1 — One migration per commit; quality gates are recorded per migration in this section so a failure is attributable to a specific migration.

single_root_lockfile_invariant.purpose: Cross-check the npm ls result against the filesystem: exactly one package-lock.json at the repo root, zero nested. See also lockfile-inventory.json (AC7, FR10).

pre_existing_failures.policy: Per spec Out-of-Scope, pre-existing failures unrelated to the upgrade are not auto-fixed; they are recorded here for attribution. If a wave resolves one of these as a side effect, mark it resolved with the wave SHA.
